etymology: From Middle English logik, from Old French logike, from Latin logica, from Ancient Greek λογική, from feminine of λογικός, from λόγος.
From Proto-Hellenic *lógos, from Proto-Indo-European *leǵ- (to collect words).
From Proto-Hellenic *légō, from Proto-Indo-European *leǵ- (to collect, gather).
